PHYSICAL EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.

2. Best practice when working on Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.
   D. Practise Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas.
   B. Practise Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas.

4. Best practice when working on Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol.
   B. Damage equipment used for Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol.
   D. Practise Javelin Throw ● Phases - Grip - Carriage - approach - cross over - release - fol with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Discus Throw: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Discus Throw.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Discus Throw.
   C. Practise Discus Throw with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Discus Throw.

6. Best practice when working on Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki.
   C. Practise Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Hiking Techniques ● Proper walking posture and pacing ● Uphill and downhill hiki.

7. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Remove the need for rules

8. Best practice when working on Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.
   C. Practise Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.

9. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Green, orange, and purple

11. Best practice when working on Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.
   B. Practise Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Overview of Hiking ● Types of hiking ● Essential hiking gear.

12. Best practice when working on Shot put: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Shot put with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Shot put.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Shot put.
   D. Damage equipment used for Shot put.

   D. Damage equipment used for Steeplechase ● Techniques - starting - running between the barriers - clearing t.

----
14. In three clear sentences, explain Volleyball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming ● Strokes - Front Crawl, - Backstroke, - Breaststroke, - Inverted breas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Discus Throw and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Shot put and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
